findings.message: The allowedCountries name "UK", which is not a two-letter code of the country table the tool reads (the ISO alpha-2 codes of the UN M49 table, and XK). The code of the United Kingdom is GB.

findings.message: The file holds the key "seedPhrase", which names a seed, a mnemonic or a private key. The tool never reads one, and the value is not shown.

findings.message: The token is not pausable (pausable is false). ERC-3643 asks that a token can be paused, so that its transfers can be stopped while a problem is found and fixed.
findings.fix: Deploy the token with the pause and unpause functions of ERC-3643 and set controls.pausable to true.
